# Hero block

> Landing page openers.

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ai-docs.mjs (npm run gen:ai). Do not edit by hand. -->

Install doc for the **Hero block** of ui-kit: 3 variants built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Hero block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `avatar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/avatar.md
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `copy-button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/copy-button.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/avatar.css";
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/copy-button.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/hero/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Hero

The opening section of a landing page: a header with the brand and a few links, one headline, one supporting sentence, the primary action, and proof that the product is real (a product mock, a visual or a customer list). A marketing block: it composes kit components with Tailwind utilities and adds no `ui-*` classes of its own.

#### Variants
```
centered    header · announcement pill · h1 · lead · 2 actions · fine print · product mock (divs)
split       header · eyebrow · h1 · lead · 2 actions · rating row  |  visual (incident card + floating card)
minimal     header (brand + one link) · mono eyebrow · two-tone h1 · lead · CLI command + CopyButton · customer names
```

#### Anatomy (centered)
```
<section>                         relative isolate overflow-hidden, rounded-2xl border bg-background
  gradient wash                   absolute, aria-hidden, -z-10, two radial gradients
  <header>                        logo link · <nav aria-label="Main"> (md+) · Sign in (sm+) + Start free
  .ui-stagger                     centred column, max-w-3xl
    pill link                     rounded-full border, <Badge size="sm">New</Badge> + text + arrow
    <h1>
    <p> lead
    actions                       <Button size="lg" asChild><a/></Button> ×2, full width on phones
    <p> fine print                "14 days free · No credit card · SOC 2 Type II"
  .ui-animate-rise (200ms delay)  product mock, bottom faded with mask-image
    <div role="img" aria-label>   browser bezel → sidebar (md+) · stats · bar chart · deploy list
```
The outer rounded border frames the block in the docs; drop `rounded-2xl border` for a full-bleed page section.

#### Visual rules
- Container `max-w-6xl` (header), `max-w-3xl` (centred copy), `max-w-5xl` (mock); side padding 20px, 32px from `sm`.
- h1: `font-display`, 600, `tracking-tight`; 32px/1.1 on phones, 40px from `sm`, 56px/1.05 from `lg` (marketing display size, outside the app type scale). Never `text-wrap: balance`.
- Lead: 15px → 17px from `sm`, `text-muted-foreground`, `max-w-xl`.
- The centred variant centres its copy; every other text block in the kit's marketing blocks is left-aligned.
- Gradients: marketing blocks only, always subtle: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-series-n) 9–14%, transparent)` in radial gradients that fade out by 70%. Never behind small body text at more than 14%.
- Product mock: semantic colours only (`bg-card`, `bg-muted`, `border-border`, `bg-series-1` bars, `bg-success`/`bg-warning` dots). No images. Bezel `bg-muted/60` with 6–8px padding; inner window `rounded-t-xl`.
- Logo: 28px `bg-primary` rounded-lg square with a two-wave stroke mark in `text-primary-foreground`.
- Split visual: incident card `rounded-2xl border bg-card`; the floating "Resolved" card sits under it on phones and overlaps the bottom-left corner from `sm` (`absolute -bottom-6 -left-4`, `shadow-md` because it floats).
- Minimal: the command box is 44px tall, `bg-card` border, mono text truncated, a ghost icon `CopyButton` with `aria-label="Copy install command"`.

#### Motion
- Heroes animate on load (they are above the fold): the copy column uses `.ui-stagger` (soft rise, 35ms per child), the visual uses `.ui-animate-rise` with a 160–200ms delay so it lands last.
- Hover: nav links fade to `text-foreground` (150ms); the pill and "see how" arrows nudge 2px right.
- Reduced motion: the global rule collapses every entrance to 1ms; nothing moves.

#### Accessibility
- One `<h1>` per page: the hero's headline.
- `<nav aria-label="Main">` for the header links; links are hidden below `md`, so a real site adds a menu button there.
- Mocks and visuals are `role="img"` with an `aria-label` that says what the picture shows; their inner text is decorative.
- The rating stars are `aria-hidden`; the text next to them carries the score.
- Every action is a real link (`<Button asChild><a href/></Button>`), 44px tall from `size="lg"`.

#### Responsive
- 360px: single column, actions stacked full width, mock shows two stats and hides the sidebar and URL bar.
- `md`: header links appear. `lg`: split goes two columns (`1fr 1.05fr`).
- No horizontal scroll at any width; long text truncates inside the mock.

#### Acceptance checks
- Renders with no layout shift and no horizontal overflow at 360px.
- Light and dark both read well; switching the accent recolours the logo, badge and primary buttons only.
- axe: no serious violations.

            Halcyon opens the incident room, pulls in the right people and links the deploy that caused it, so
            on-call engineers fix the problem instead of hunting for context.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-2.5 sm:flex-row">
            <Button size="lg" asChild>
              <a href="#">Start free trial</a>
            </Button>
            <Button size="lg" variant="ghost" asChild>
              <a href="#">
                See how it works
                <Icon name="arrow-right" />
              </a>
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-10 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 border-t border-border pt-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
                <Icon key={i} name="star" size={14} fill="currentColor" strokeWidth={0} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">4.9 out of 5</span> from 1,200 on-call engineers
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="ui-animate-rise min-w-0 [animation-delay:160ms] lg:pl-6">
          <IncidentVisual />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

                {name}
              </li>
            ))}

      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
